body:
Sources for "Delhi NCR's air turns 'severe' as pollution readings pass 450 and primary schools move online", from the story's brief (latest update 3 Nov, 09:20 IST).

1. 2 Nov, 07:00 IST: air quality across Delhi NCR falls to 'severe' as readings pass 450.
   Link: https://example.com/sources/delhi-air-quality-monday-morning
   Checked: did not open (404, not found).

2. 2 Nov, 11:35 IST: schools across Delhi NCR move classes online until Friday. Corrected in entry 4.
   Link: https://example.com/sources/delhi-schools-notice
   Link: https://example.org/posts/noida-parents-group
   Checked: neither opened (404, not found).

3. 2 Nov, 15:10 IST: building work stops and diesel trucks are kept out of Delhi under the emergency rules.
   Link: https://example.com/sources/delhi-emergency-rules
   Checked: did not open (404, not found).

4. 3 Nov, 09:20 IST: correction of entry 2: only Delhi's primary schools moved online; schools in Noida and Gurugram stay open.
   Link: https://example.com/sources/delhi-schools-clarification
   Checked: did not open (404, not found).

Please send: a working source for each of the four claims above. I checked all five links on 18 Nov 2026 with a link checker and each answered 404, not found, so none can be relied on yet. If you have a source that opens, please send it.
